title: An inverted annihilator descends generic nilpotence
statement: Let A, B, R0 be commutative rings with A-algebra structures on B and R0. Let F be a field with compatible A- and R0-algebra structures. Suppose t in R0 has the property that every x in B tensor_A R0 whose image in B tensor_A F is nilpotent satisfies that (1 tensor t)x is nilpotent. Let s in R0 be divisible by t, and let R=R0[1/s] have compatible A-, R0-, and F-algebra maps, with F a fraction field of R. For every x in B tensor_A R, nilpotence of its image in B tensor_A F implies nilpotence of x.

proof.text: Write l:B tensor_A R0 to B tensor_A R for the tensor map, m for the tensor map to B tensor_A F, and d=1 tensor image(s). Prove by tensor induction that every x in B tensor_A R satisfies x*d^n=l(y) for some n and y. For a pure tensor b tensor c use IsLocalization.Away.surj to clear the denominator of c. For a sum with denominators d^n and d^k, use denominator d^(n+k) and numerator y*(1 tensor s)^k+v*(1 tensor s)^n. The zero tensor has denominator exponent zero.

The tensor maps satisfy m(l(y))=m0(y), proved by tensor induction and IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply. If m(x) is nilpotent, then m0(y)=m(x)*m(d)^n is nilpotent. Apply the hypothesis on t to y and map this nilpotence along l. This gives nilpotence of (1 tensor image(t))*(x*d^n).

IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd makes image(t) a unit, because t divides s. IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit makes image(s) a unit. Map these units into the tensor algebra with includeRight. Remove the unit factors 1 tensor image(t) and d^n using IsUnit.isNilpotent_unit_mul_of_commute_iff and IsUnit.isNilpotent_mul_unit_of_commute_iff. The remaining element x is nilpotent. This also covers the zero tensor algebra; incompatible zero localizations have no asserted field-algebra instances.

theorem generic_tensor_nilpotence_of_annihilator
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (R0 : Type w) [CommRing R0] [Algebra A R0]
    (F : Type z) [Field F] [Algebra A F] [Algebra R0 F]
    [IsScalarTower A R0 F]
    (t : R0)
    (ht : ∀ x : B ⊗[A] R0,
      IsNilpotent (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A B)
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A R0 F) x) →
      IsNilpotent ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] t * x))
    (s : R0) (hts : t ∣ s)
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra R0 R] [IsLocalization.Away s R]
    [Algebra A R] [IsScalarTower A R0 R] [Algebra R F]
    [IsScalarTower R0 R F] [IsScalarTower A R F] [IsFractionRing R F]
    (x : B ⊗[A] R) :
    IsNilpotent (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A B)
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A R F) x) → IsNilpotent x
